$comment: Layout table for the skilldesc.txt 'descline'/'dsc2line'/'dsc3line' description functions. Each key is the numeric column value; the object describes how the sibling desctextA / desctextB / desccalcA / desccalcB columns bind to the translated template. Add a row here (no recompile) when a mod introduces a description function the exporter has not seen — unknown functions are skipped and reported as warnings in extras/import-report.txt.
$layoutNote: layout: 'textOnly' = template takes no numeric argument; 'singleValue' = one argument from calcA; 'valueWithDivisor' = one argument, calcA / calcB (calcB defaults to 1); 'twoValues' = two arguments, calcA then calcB; 'sumOfValues' = one argument, calcA + calcB.
$pluralNote: plural: desctextA is the singular template and desctextB the plural one; the website picks by the rendered value (1 => singular).
$nameArgNote: nameArg: desctextB is not a template but a translation key spliced in as the template's leading %s argument (synergy / bonus-source lines).
